name: Discord
summary: Discord offers OAuth2 as a way for applications to authenticate users and access API resources. Several OAuth2 flows are available for different use cases.
decision: Begin setting up OAuth2 for your Discord application by registering for a developer application to obtain essential credentials, then select the right OAuth2 flow based on your requirements.

auth_type.value: OAuth2 is the standard authorization framework used by Discord.

setup_path.label: Own app unless managed auth is confirmed

execution_note: No OAuth flow was executed for this guide. Documented claims are statements in pages retrieved for this run. Inferred claims are a reading of those pages, not a direct statement. Unknown means the retrieved pages did not establish it. Verified is reserved for a setup this project has run, and research does not use it.

composio.decision: Begin setting up OAuth2 for your Discord application by registering for a developer application to obtain essential credentials, then select the right OAuth2 flow based on your requirements.

steps.title: Register your application
steps.body: Visit the Discord Developer Portal and create a new application to obtain a client ID and client secret.

steps.title: Decide on OAuth2 flow
steps.body: Choose the appropriate OAuth2 flow such as authorization code or client credentials based on your needs.

steps.title: Configure redirect URI
steps.body: Set the redirect URI in your application's settings in the Developer Portal.

human_actions.title: Register an application
human_actions.body: Create a new application in the Discord Developer Portal to initiate your OAuth2 setup.

human_actions.title: Implement OAuth2 flow
human_actions.body: Develop the necessary code for implementing the OAuth2 flow selected for your application.
